name: direct build request
prompt: Build me a REST API in Node for a small invoicing app: users, invoices, and payments. It will handle real customer data, so do it properly.

name: make it production-ready
prompt: This repo is my side-project API and I'm about to put it on a public server. Make it production-ready before I do.

name: audit request
prompt: Audit this codebase for production readiness. I need to know what would actually get us breached or cause data loss before launch, not a list of style nits.

name: code review request
prompt: Review this pull request properly before I merge it. It's the new payment refund flow and I don't trust that it's safe yet.

name: grill my plan before building
prompt: Grill my plan before I build anything: I want to add WebSocket live updates to our analytics dashboard. Tear the plan apart first, then we'll decide whether to build it.

name: secure existing code
prompt: Secure this Express app. It handles login sessions and user file uploads and I suspect it's wide open.

name: optimize existing code
prompt: This Python data pipeline is too slow and keeps running out of memory on large files. Optimize it without changing its output format.

name: improve reliability and tests
prompt: Improve this repo: the tests are flaky, half the critical paths have no coverage, and I keep shipping regressions. Make it trustworthy.

name: build a publishable browser extension
prompt: I want a Chrome extension that compares prices across tabs while I shop. Build it to a standard I could actually publish on the Web Store.

name: design and build a multi-tenant backend
prompt: Design and build the backend for a multi-tenant SaaS task tracker: Postgres storage, per-tenant data isolation, and an API other developers will integrate against.

name: typo fix in a comment
prompt: Fix the typo in the comment at the top of server.js: it says 'recieve' and it should say 'receive'. Nothing else.

name: git how-to question
prompt: How do I undo my last git commit without losing the changes I made in it?

name: general knowledge question
prompt: What's the difference between a process and a thread?

name: prose / essay edit
prompt: Can you polish this paragraph of my cover letter so it sounds more confident? 'I was responsible for various tasks and helped the team with many projects.'

name: one-line config question
prompt: What single line do I add to .gitignore so it ignores node_modules?

name: factual status-code lookup
prompt: Which HTTP status code means 'Too Many Requests'?

name: translation request
prompt: Translate 'the build failed and we rolled it back' into German.
